id: 15_60 Most Basic Safety Interview Questions & Answers Construction Safety Interview
title: 安全知识四关挑战
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/15_60 Most Basic Safety Interview Questions & Answers Construction Safety Interview.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/15_60 Most Basic Safety Interview Questions & Answers Construction Safety Interview/src.py

points.K5: 工地必备安全帽和安全鞋
points.K7: 搭不了架子：安全网和安全带
points.K23: 潮湿狭小处用安全电压灯

shots.scene: 欣欣站在校园里，身后是带围挡的施工工地，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands on a university campus in front of a fenced construction site and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 你好！今天来闯安全知识四关！

shots.scene: 安全帽、闪电、铁锹、脚手架四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a hard hat, a lightning bolt, a shovel and a scaffold frame. No people.
shots.narration: 施工、用电、开挖、脚手架，各一关。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研走过工地围挡，好奇地往里看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student walk past a construction fence on campus and look curiously inside.
shots.narration: 学校新实验楼开工了。

shots.scene: 老李戴着安全帽站在围挡门口，拦住他们
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a hard hat stands at the fence gate and stops the two students.
shots.narration: 老李说：工地里处处是隐患。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头：这和我们做实验有关吗？
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a puzzled look while the facility engineer smiles.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：这跟我们有关系吗？

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一块空白闯关牌，三人围过来
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank challenge board, and the three others gather around.
shots.narration: 欣欣说：闯完四关，你就明白了。

shots.scene: 屋顶上有一片发白的易碎采光板，旁边挂着警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A rooftop with a pale fragile skylight panel and a warning sign placed beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一关：易碎屋面上怎么作业？

shots.scene: 警告标志特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a general warning sign at the edge of a fragile roof area. No people.
shots.narration: 先挂警示，提醒人别踩上去。

shots.scene: 长条爬板横跨在屋面上
shots.prompt_en: A long crawling board laid across a roof surface to spread the load. No people.
shots.narration: 再铺爬板或梯子，分散重量。

shots.scene: 深沟槽两侧被支撑板撑住
shots.prompt_en: A deep trench whose walls are held by vertical shoring boards and cross struts. No people.
shots.narration: 人在深沟里干活，沟壁要撑住，

shots.scene: 沟槽两侧挖成斜坡
shots.prompt_en: A trench with both sides cut back into gentle slopes. No people.
shots.narration: 或者把沟壁挖成斜坡，防坍塌。

shots.scene: 地面剖面图：地下埋着水管、排水管和电缆
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of the ground showing a water main, a drain pipe and a power cable buried underground. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖之前，先查清地下管线。

shots.scene: 铁锹碰到电缆冒火花的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a shovel hitting a buried cable with sparks, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 挖断电缆水管，后果很严重。

shots.scene: 脚手架平台边缘的踢脚板挡住一个滚动的扳手
shots.prompt_en: A toe board at the edge of a scaffold platform stops a rolling wrench from falling. No people.
shots.narration: 踢脚板挡住物料，不让它掉下去，

shots.scene: 人形图标滑倒，被踢脚板和护栏挡住
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram slips on a platform and is stopped by the toe board and guardrail. No people.
shots.narration: 也防人从护栏下面滑出去。

shots.scene: 空白标准手册图标旁一个向上箭头
shots.prompt_en: A closed standards handbook with a blank cover next to an upward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 它的高度，有规定的最低值。

shots.section_title: 工地必备安全帽和安全鞋
shots.scene: 工地入口处，老李戴安全帽、穿安全鞋
shots.prompt_en: At a site entrance, the facility engineer wears a hard hat and safety shoes.
shots.narration: 进工地，人人戴安全帽穿安全鞋。
overlay: 工地必备安全帽和安全鞋

shots.scene: 上方落下一块砖，被安全帽挡开
shots.prompt_en: A falling brick bounces off a hard hat. No people.
shots.narration: 安全帽能挡住掉下来的东西，

shots.scene: 人形图标头部撞到低矮横梁，安全帽护住
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram bumps into a low steel beam and the hard hat protects the head. No people.
shots.narration: 也能减轻头撞到构件的伤害。

shots.section_title: 搭不了架子：安全网和安全带
shots.scene: 高处墙边张着安全网，老李系着安全带
shots.prompt_en: A safety net stretched below a high work edge, and the facility engineer wearing a full body harness clipped to an anchor.
shots.narration: 搭不了脚手架，就用安全网和安全带。
overlay: 搭不了架子：安全网和安全带

shots.scene: 地面开口四周围着坚固的围挡，挂着警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A floor opening surrounded by a rigid barrier with a warning sign attached. No people.
shots.narration: 坑洞和楼板开口，要硬隔离、挂警示。

shots.scene: 只拉一根塑料带的开口图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a floor opening marked only with a loose plastic tape, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一根彩带挡不住人。

shots.scene: 脚手架边上下两道护栏和踢脚板
shots.prompt_en: The edge of a scaffold platform with a top rail, a middle rail and a toe board. No people.
shots.narration: 护栏高度有上下限，按规定装。

shots.scene: 护栏与踢脚板间空隙大时加中间护栏
shots.prompt_en: A middle guardrail is added to close a wide gap between the top rail and the toe board. No people.
shots.narration: 空隙太大，就加一道中间护栏。

shots.scene: 河边作业的人形图标穿着救生衣，旁边停着一条小船
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram working by a river wears a life jacket, and a small boat waits nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 水上作业：穿救生衣，旁边备船。

shots.scene: 沟槽箱内装着固定直梯，梯子顶端高出地面
shots.prompt_en: A trench box with a fixed vertical ladder inside, its top extending above the ground edge. No people.
shots.narration: 沟槽箱里要装固定直梯，

shots.scene: 梯子高出踏出点的箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow showing the ladder rising above the stepping off point. No people.
shots.narration: 梯子要高出地面一截，方便上下。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表站在脚手架前
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank checklist in front of a scaffold.
shots.narration: 脚手架要由合格人员检查。

shots.scene: 四个图标：开始使用、加建、暴风雨、被车撞
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a start flag, a scaffold with added sections, a storm cloud and a vehicle bumping a scaffold. No people.
shots.narration: 使用前、改动后、恶劣天气后、被撞后。

shots.scene: 工人图标拆下一根挡路的钢管，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a worker removing a scaffold tube that blocks his way, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 嫌脚手架碍事，能自己拆吗？不能！

shots.scene: 脚手架少了一根杆后摇晃
shots.prompt_en: A scaffold frame with one tube missing starts to sway. No people.
shots.narration: 少一根杆，整个架子都可能不稳。

shots.scene: 老李持空白作业许可单，指挥专业架子工调整
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a blank work permit while a competent scaffolder adjusts the scaffold.
shots.narration: 只能由专业架子工，凭许可来拆。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白法规手册旁和施工方交谈
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator talks with a contractor beside a blank regulations handbook.
shots.narration: 安全员：指导施工方守法规，

shots.scene: 王老师巡视工地，在空白记录本上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks around the site ticking a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 监督落实，发现问题及时纠正。

shots.scene: 开工前一群工人围着老李听讲
shots.prompt_en: Before work starts, a group of workers stands around the facility engineer listening to a short briefing.
shots.narration: 开工前组织班前安全交底。

shots.scene: 王老师与另一位安全顾问握手
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shakes hands with another safety advisor holding a blank folder.
shots.narration: 还要配合安全顾问的工作。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻出第二块闯关牌，牌上是闪电
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot flips to a second blank challenge board showing a lightning bolt icon.
shots.narration: 第二关：用电。熔断器管什么？

shots.scene: 过热导线旁熔断器熔断，电路变暗
shots.prompt_en: A fuse melts beside an overheating wire and the circuit goes dark. No people.
shots.narration: 电流超标时它熔断，保护线路。

shots.scene: 断路器拨杆上下，灯随之亮灭
shots.prompt_en: A circuit breaker lever moves up and down and a lamp turns on and off with it. No people.
shots.narration: 断路器用来接通和断开电流。

shots.scene: 冒烟的插座旁，水桶图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A smoking socket with a water bucket icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电气着火不泼水，水会导电短路。

shots.scene: 地上的电线被推车压、被人绊
shots.prompt_en: A cord on the floor being run over by a cart and tripping a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 电线落地，易压坏，还绊人。

shots.scene: 老李穿绝缘靴站在绝缘垫上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands on an insulating mat wearing insulating boots.
shots.narration: 不靠跳闸，靠绝缘垫和绝缘靴防触电。

shots.scene: 破损电器冒火花引燃纸箱，旁边爆炸符号
shots.prompt_en: A damaged appliance throws sparks that ignite a cardboard box, with an explosion symbol nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 故障电器还会引起火灾、爆炸。

shots.scene: 回字形双方框标志特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a symbol of one square inside another square on a blank nameplate. No people.
shots.narration: 两个方框套一起，是双重绝缘。

shots.scene: 手检查插头和电源线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands checking a plug and running along a power cord.
shots.narration: 工具用前，查插头、查电线。

shots.section_title: 潮湿狭小处用安全电压灯
shots.scene: 潮湿坑里的行灯连着小变压器图标
shots.prompt_en: A hand lamp in a damp pit connected to a small safety transformer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 潮湿狭小处，用规定的安全电压灯。
overlay: 潮湿狭小处用安全电压灯

shots.scene: 一只手拉下总开关
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand pulling down a main switch lever.
shots.narration: 有人触电：先断电，

shots.scene: 干燥木棍挑开电线；老李做胸外按压，小研打电话
shots.prompt_en: A dry wooden stick pushes a wire away; then the facility engineer performs chest compressions on a manikin while the female graduate student phones for help.
shots.narration: 断不了就用干木棍挑开，再急救。

shots.scene: AED 箱打开
shots.prompt_en: A defibrillator cabinet on a wall is opened. No people.
shots.narration: 做心肺复苏，打120，取AED。

shots.scene: 电压、交直流、心形、电流四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a voltmeter, alternating and direct current symbols, a heart and a thick current arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 电压、交直流、体质、电流大小。

shots.scene: 闪电、火焰、爆炸三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a lightning bolt, a flame and an explosion symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 用电三大危害：电击、火灾、爆炸。

shots.scene: 老李在断电的线路上用空白表盘测试仪测量
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests a switched off circuit with a test meter that has a blank dial.
shots.narration: 绝缘电阻测试，查线路有没有漏电。

shots.scene: 户外变压器四周围着高围栏，门上挂高压警告标志
shots.prompt_en: An outdoor transformer inside a tall fence with a high voltage warning sign on the locked gate. No people.
shots.narration: 户外高压设备，要用高围栏隔开。

shots.scene: 昏暗灯下，打哈欠、出错、皱眉、摔倒四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Under a dim lamp, four icons: a yawning person, a wrong mark, a frowning face and a falling person. No people.
shots.narration: 照明不好：疲劳、出错、紧张、出事。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻出第三块闯关牌，牌上是铁锹
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot flips to a third blank challenge board showing a shovel icon.
shots.narration: 第三关：开挖。多久查一次？

shots.scene: 雨后的基坑边，老李拿空白检查表查看
shots.prompt_en: After rain, the facility engineer inspects the wet edge of an excavation with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 要定期检查，下过雨更要查。

shots.scene: 松软砂土的沟槽旁，深度箭头到达一条线后出现支撑板
shots.prompt_en: Beside a trench in loose sandy soil, a depth arrow reaches a marked line and shoring boards appear. No people.
shots.narration: 松土砂土，挖到一定深度就要支护。

shots.scene: 挖掘机周围画着一个危险圈
shots.prompt_en: An excavator with a circular danger zone marked on the ground around it. No people.
shots.narration: 挖掘机转臂范围内，平时不能进。

shots.scene: 老李向驾驶室挥手示意，司机点头，机器停下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer waves to the excavator operator, who nods, and the machine stops.
shots.narration: 非进不可：先让司机知道，

shots.scene: 停稳的挖掘机，铲斗放在地上
shots.prompt_en: A stopped excavator with its bucket resting on the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 等机器完全停下再进去。

shots.scene: 地面上挖出的坑、沟、洼地三个剖面
shots.prompt_en: Three ground cross-sections: a pit, a long trench and a shallow depression dug out of the soil. No people.
shots.narration: 取土挖出的坑、沟、洼地，都叫开挖。

shots.scene: 窄而深的沟槽剖面，深度箭头比宽度长
shots.prompt_en: A narrow deep trench cross-section with a depth arrow longer than the width arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 又窄又深、深度大于宽度，叫沟槽。

shots.scene: 沟壁被木板和横撑撑住
shots.prompt_en: Trench walls held by boards and cross struts. No people.
shots.narration: 撑住沟壁、防塌方的结构叫支撑。

shots.scene: 长沟槽里每隔一段放着一架梯子
shots.prompt_en: A long trench with ladders placed at intervals along its length. No people.
shots.narration: 长沟里要隔一段就有梯子出口，

shots.scene: 人形图标在沟里，最近的梯子就在附近
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram inside a trench with the nearest ladder close by. No people.
shots.narration: 出事时能很快爬上来。

shots.scene: 深坑口放着受限空间警示标志和气体检测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: A deep pit entrance with a confined space warning sign and a gas detector icon. No people.
shots.narration: 坑挖得深，就按受限空间来管。

shots.scene: 沟壁土块剥落滑下的剖面图
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section showing a mass of soil breaking away from a trench wall and sliding down. No people.
shots.narration: 沟壁土石脱落、沟底土流失，

shots.scene: 人形图标被土埋的图标，警告三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person pictogram partly buried by soil, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 就是塌方，会把人埋住。

shots.scene: 断裂管道、坠入坑中的车辆图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a broken buried pipe and a vehicle tipping into an excavation. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖危害：挖坏管线，人车物坠落，

shots.scene: 塌方土堆和有毒易燃气体云图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a collapsing soil pile and a toxic flammable gas cloud above a pit. No people.
shots.narration: 还有塌方，有毒易燃气体。

shots.scene: 铁锹和挖掘机两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a shovel and an excavator. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖分人工开挖和机械开挖。

shots.scene: 四个剖面：支撑、台阶、斜坡、板桩
shots.prompt_en: Four cross-section icons: shored walls, stepped benches, a sloped side and driven sheet piles. No people.
shots.narration: 护边坡：支撑、台阶、放坡、板桩。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻出第四块闯关牌，牌上是脚手架
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot flips to a fourth blank challenge board showing a scaffold icon.
shots.narration: 第四关：脚手架。搭之前看什么？

shots.scene: 地面剖面：地下室、排水沟、软土，压上重物后下陷
shots.prompt_en: A ground cross-section with a basement void, a drain and a soft soil patch that sinks under a heavy load. No people.
shots.narration: 看地下有无空洞、沟渠和软土。

shots.scene: 移动脚手架的轮子、刹车、支腿、内梯依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: On a mobile scaffold tower, the wheel locks, brakes, outriggers and internal ladder light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 租移动脚手架：轮能锁、刹车灵，

shots.scene: 支腿外伸撑稳，内置梯子特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of outriggers extended for stability and a fixed internal ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 有支腿撑稳，有内梯上下。

shots.scene: 脚手架平台上堆着材料，旁边一个秤砣图标
shots.prompt_en: Materials stacked on a scaffold platform next to a weight icon. No people.
shots.narration: 堆料之前，先弄清它能承多重。

shots.scene: 脚手架护栏、踢脚板旁边还挂着防护网
shots.prompt_en: A scaffold with guardrails and toe boards and an extra protective mesh screen fitted. No people.
shots.narration: 护栏踢脚板之外，其他防护也要齐。

shots.scene: 移动脚手架高度箭头与底宽箭头对比
shots.prompt_en: A mobile scaffold tower with a height arrow compared to its narrow base width arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 移动脚手架不能太高，和底宽成比例，

shots.scene: 较高的移动脚手架用拉杆与建筑物连接
shots.prompt_en: A taller mobile scaffold tower tied to a building with ties. No people.
shots.narration: 高了还要和建筑物拉结。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表，依次指向立杆、横杆、斜撑
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank checklist and points in turn to the vertical tubes, horizontal tubes and diagonal braces of a scaffold.
shots.narration: 检查立杆、横杆、斜撑，

shots.scene: 拉结点、扣件、平台板特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-ups of a building tie, a coupler and a platform board. No people.
shots.narration: 拉结、扣件、平台板，

shots.scene: 护栏、踢脚板和梯子特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-ups of a guardrail, a toe board and a secured ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 还有护栏、踢脚板和梯子。

shots.scene: 一座脚手架托着工人图标和材料图标
shots.prompt_en: A scaffold supporting a worker pictogram and stacked materials at height. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架是高处托人托料的临时结构。

shots.scene: 红、黄、绿三块空白挂牌挂在脚手架入口
shots.prompt_en: Three blank tags in red, yellow and green hanging at a scaffold access point. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架上常挂红、黄、绿三色牌。

shots.scene: 阿杰停在挂牌前，转头问老李
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops in front of a scaffold tag and turns to ask the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 看牌再用，看不懂就问管理人员。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起加分牌，牌上是围挡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank bonus board showing a construction fence icon.
shots.narration: 加分题：校园在施工，怎么办？

shots.scene: 学生翻越围挡、抄近路穿工地的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a student climbing a construction fence and taking a shortcut through the site, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不进围挡，不抄近路穿工地。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研绕行，沿着指示走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student follow a detour path marked by direction arrows around the fence.
shots.narration: 按指示绕行，远离吊装区下方。

shots.scene: 小研站在稳固的踏凳上从高柜取物
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands on a sturdy step stool to take a box from a high lab shelf.
shots.narration: 实验室高处取物，用稳固的踏凳。

shots.scene: 站在转椅、纸箱上的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person standing on a swivel chair and on a cardboard box, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不站转椅、纸箱和实验凳。

shots.scene: 重物和玻璃瓶放在柜子下层
shots.prompt_en: Heavy items and glass bottles stored on the lower shelves of a cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 重物和易碎品放在低处。

shots.scene: 实验楼地面的检修口没有盖板，周围摆着围挡
shots.prompt_en: An open service hatch in a lab building floor surrounded by a temporary barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 地面开口、沟盖缺失，要围起来。

shots.scene: 阿杰拍下开口，向王老师报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at the open hatch and reports it to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 发现了，立即报告，等专人处理。

shots.scene: 野外实习地点，学生们拿着铁锹准备挖土样
shots.prompt_en: At a field practice site, students hold small shovels, ready to dig soil samples.
shots.narration: 野外实习挖坑取样，也有风险。

shots.scene: 王老师审阅空白计划表，学生两人一组
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews a blank field plan while students form pairs.
shots.narration: 先报备计划，结伴行动。

shots.scene: 浅坑旁的学生不进入深坑，坑边堆土远离边缘
shots.prompt_en: A student stays out of a deep pit, and excavated soil is piled away from the pit edge. No people.
shots.narration: 不单独下深坑，土堆离坑边远点。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰在桌前填写空白风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student fill in a blank risk assessment form at a desk.
shots.narration: 工地有班前交底，实验也一样。

shots.scene: 危险、措施、应急三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a warning triangle, a shield and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 想清风险、防护和应急，再动手。

shots.scene: 王老师在表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs the blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 新实验、新设备，先过负责人这关。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在四块闯关牌前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of four blank challenge boards with icons of a hard hat, a lightning bolt, a shovel and a scaffold.
shots.narration: 四关闯完，我们来回顾。

shots.scene: 安全帽、安全网、围挡三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a hard hat, a safety net and a rigid barrier around an opening. No people.
shots.narration: 施工：防坠物、防坠落、开口围好。

shots.scene: 熔断器、绝缘靴、断电开关三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a fuse, insulating boots and a switched off breaker. No people.
shots.narration: 用电：有保护，有绝缘，触电先断电。

shots.scene: 支撑沟槽、挖掘机危险圈、受限空间标志三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a shored trench, an excavator danger zone and a confined space sign. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖：查管线、做支护、防塌方。

shots.scene: 脚手架、检查表、彩色挂牌三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a scaffold, a checklist and colored scaffold tags. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架：先检查，不擅拆，看挂牌。

shots.scene: 阿杰点头，看向实验楼
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods and looks toward the lab building.
shots.narration: 这些道理，实验室里同样适用。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李、阿杰和小研在工地围挡外一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye outside the construction fence.
shots.narration: 四关全过，安全第一，下次见！
